answer: Cross-epoch signature continuity rule: agents submit signed behavioural summaries (action-type histograms, timing fingerprints) each epoch. To advance past a summit threshold, an identity must show smooth divergence between successive summaries, tracked as a glacier-like drift metric. A identity whose behaviour shifts faster than the drift bound—typical of freshly cloned sybils initialized from a template—gets its trust capped.
